body.message:
we can offer you the following final rates for your requested 4-month stay:

October: AED 11,000
November: AED 12,500
January: AED 15,500
February: AED 13,500

The total for 4 months (120 nights) would be AED 52,500, which works out to an average of AED 13,125 per month.

We can offer this as our final fixed rate. Unfortunately, we are unable to reduce the rate any further.

Please let us know if this works for you, and we will be happy to proceed with the booking.

Thank you for your understanding.
